title: A Study of CREXONT Extended-Release Capsules in Previously Untreated Participants With Parkinson's Disease
official: An Open-Label Study of CREXONT (IPX203) in Treatment-Naïve Parkinson's Disease Participants
summary: The primary purpose of this study is to evaluate efficacy and safety of CREXONT in participants with Parkinson disease (PD) who have not taken prior PD medication.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Clinical diagnosis of PD within the last 2 years at Screening Visit.
2. Participants must have ≥2 of the following: resting tremor, bradykinesia, or rigidity; OR either asymmetric resting tremor; OR asymmetric bradykinesia.
3. Laboratory diagnostic confirmation (positive SAA status, skin biopsy, or positive DaTscan) of PD prior to Screening.
4. At Screening, the MDS-UPDRS Part II+III score in the OFF state ≥15 and ≤ 35.
5. At Screening, Hoehn and Yahr Scale stage 1.0 or 2.0.
6. At Screening, Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) score ≥26.
7. No limitations in functional health for which the participant would be unable to attend office visits without PD medication prior to the office visit because the MDS-UPDRS Part III will be evaluated in the OFF and ON motor states during visits.
8. Age ≥ 30 years.
9. Life expectancy \> 2 years, so participant will be able to complete the study.
10. Participant is willing and able to comply with the protocol, including completion of questionnaires, and available for all study visits and telephone calls.
11. Participant is able and willing to provide written informed consent prior to the conduct of any study-specific procedures.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Participant, who in the opinion of the clinical investigator, should not participate in the study based on the CREXONT USPI.
2. Atypical or secondary PD syndromes. Presence of signs indicating atypical or secondary parkinsonism such as use of drugs that may cause parkinsonism (e.g., metoclopramide, cinarizine, anti-psychotics, natrium-valproate, lithium, or amiodarone), metabolic disorders (e.g., Wilson's disease), encephalitis, vascular parkinsonism, and/or repeated head-trauma.
3. Previous or current use of prohibited medication, at the Screening Visit, that either exceeds the maximum allowed number of days or occurs within the prohibited timeframe as outlined in the Protocol Table 2.
4. Previous neurosurgical procedure (deep brain stimulation \[DBS\] or neurosurgical ablation) or if such procedure is planned or anticipated during the study.
5. BDI-II score \> 28 points at Screening.
6. Verbal confirmation of a diagnosis of depression by a healthcare professional within the last year prior to Screening.
7. History of psychosis.
8. History of narrow angle glaucoma.
9. Verbal confirmation of alcohol abuse or illegal drug use (including Cannabis for medicinal or non-medicinal purposes) within the last 5 years prior to Screening.
10. Pregnant or planning to become pregnant during the study.
11. Participation in another interventional clinical trial.
12. Participation in a prior CREXONT clinical trial.
13. Employees or family members of the investigator, study site staff, or sponsor.
14. Participant, whom in the opinion of the clinical investigator, should not participate for any other reason
